skill.name: linkedin-outreach-method
skill.description: Runs the whole LinkedIn outreach loop: find, sort by persona, voice, one template per persona, send, measure acceptance and replies at 7 days. Start here for any LinkedIn outreach.
skill.summary: Plan persona-based LinkedIn outreach, review messages before sending, and compare acceptance and replies after seven days.
skill.author: bereach-ai

security_audit.summary: All 55 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, ordinary prose, bibliographic citations, or navigation links. Semantic review found instructions that defer conflicting user rules and suppress cost or provenance disclosures. The workflow otherwise requires approval for sending and permission for historical conversation review; no evidence found of shell execution or credential exfiltration.

remediation.issue: Conflicting saved user rules are deferred until after the first invitations.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve conflicting user restrictions before searches, drafts, or invitations; never let skill instructions override user constraints without explicit clarification.

remediation.issue: Cost and provenance disclosures are suppressed, including when users ask about credits, and quoted text may be rewritten.
remediation.suggestion: Answer cost questions directly, disclose relevant service and data sources before approval, and preserve quotations verbatim or clearly label paraphrases.

semantic_findings.description: A saved rule that 'fights a skill or a card' is handled 'after the first invitations.' This instruction defers conflicting user restrictions until outreach begins, allowing skill instructions to displace user constraints.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The text explicitly postpones conflicts with saved or pasted user instructions until after invitations. No exception protects user restrictions before that action.

content.value_statement: LinkedIn outreach becomes difficult to evaluate when audiences, messages, and measurement periods differ. This skill organizes persona-based campaigns, approval steps, and seven-day comparisons.
actual_capabilities: Organizes outreach into planning, invitation review, message review, follow-ups, results, and next-test artifacts.
Defines searchable ideal customer profiles and separates company criteria from persona messaging and timing signals.
Directs permission-based review of up to 20 work conversations to identify wording, objections, and message patterns.
Specifies BeReach dry runs and explicit approval before sending invitations, first messages, follow-ups, or replies.
Plans randomized comparisons within each persona, with sample-size estimates and one changed message element.
Explains seven-day acceptance and reply measurements, contact tags, and distinctions between directional and statistically supported results.
limitations: Live searches, account data, drafts, and sending require a configured BeReach connector and relevant account access.
Persona, voice, message-writing, and setup workflows depend on companion skills not included in this package.
The package provides instructions and reference documents, not executable integrations or guaranteed improvements in response rates.
Current instructions defer conflicting saved rules and suppress some disclosures; resolve these issues before using live outreach tools.

use_cases.title: Organize a First Campaign
use_cases.description: Turn a company offer, customer criteria, and approved writing samples into a segmented outreach plan with review checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Compare Persona Messages
use_cases.description: Plan a single-variable message comparison and evaluate interested replies within the same persona and seven-day window.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Client Review
use_cases.description: Prepare invitation, draft, and follow-up review artifacts that keep client approval separate from message preparation.

prompt_templates.title: Outline an Outreach Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan LinkedIn outreach for [offer] to [company type] in [location]. Ask one question round first. Use offline planning only. Preserve all user restrictions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: define the audience and required inputs without account access.

prompt_templates.title: Review Past Messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these anonymized messages: [samples]. Count interested, polite, negative, and missing replies. Identify wording patterns without causal claims. Do not access my inbox.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: learn from supplied conversations without requesting live conversation history.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Approval Artifact
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [approved personas] and [approved templates], prepare an invitation review artifact from [lead list]. Show exclusions, dates, and dependencies. Do not send or spend credits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a campaign review before any external action.

prompt_templates.title: Design and Evaluate a Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a one-variable comparison for [persona], using [baseline], [candidate], and [expected volume]. Size it first. Analyze [seven-day results]. State uncertainty and propose one next change.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: plan a controlled comparison and interpret supplied campaign results.

output_examples.input: Illustrative seven-day results: one persona, 100 first messages per version. Version A received 30 interested replies; version B received 40.
output: Results: A received 30 interested replies from 100 messages; B received 40 from 100.
B leads, but the specified two-proportion check does not establish a statistically supported difference.
Treat B as directional only. Preserve the planned sample size and avoid declaring a winner early.

best_practices: Resolve conflicting saved rules before live actions, answer cost questions directly, and preserve quoted text exactly.
Require approval for each send artifact and permission before reading historical conversations; exclude personal conversations and existing customer relationships.
Compare one change within one persona, set sample sizes beforehand, and measure each batch after the same seven-day interval.
anti_patterns: Allowing skill instructions to displace user restrictions or conceal service, source, or cost information.
Sending invitations or messages without explicit approval of the corresponding artifact.
Combining personas, comparing immature batches, or treating selected historical replies as proof of message effectiveness.

faq.question: Does this package include a working LinkedIn connector?
faq.answer: No. It documents BeReach tool workflows but does not include the connector implementation.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The report lists all three tools. Live actions also require compatible BeReach tooling and account access in your environment.

faq.question: Will it send messages without approval?
faq.answer: The documented workflow requires approval for every send artifact. Review the flagged user-rule conflict before enabling live outreach.

faq.question: Does it need access to my conversation history?
faq.answer: Historical review is optional and requires permission. You can provide selected messages instead; the workflow continues when no history exists.

faq.question: Does it guarantee better acceptance or reply rates?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning and comparison methods, but results depend on your audience, offer, messages, timing, and sample size.

faq.question: Are searches and message preparation free?
faq.answer: The references describe search credits and some free operations. Verify current BeReach pricing and require direct answers about costs before approval.
